root_cause: The diagnostic workflow ran only the normalize stage of the canonical pricing/site pipeline before the legacy Python SEO audit. That skipped the pipeline's verify/finalization phase, so the audit could inspect an intermediate transformed estate rather than canonical final production output.
prevention: SEO diagnostics must run the complete canonical production pipeline before legacy page/SEO auditing.
Regression coverage pins BG_PRICING_STAGE=all in the diagnostic workflow.
